title: Visitor journeys
originalHint: Original Swetrix Sankey diagram and path table. This view uses raw page paths and multi-page sessions; counts differ from the new views, which include single-page visits and grouped detail pages. For a specific user's paths, use Path list, Flow diagram or Path conversion.
searchEmpty: No matching identified user. Try the numeric user ID.
searchMore: More matches exist. Refine your email search.
identityHint: User paths include pageviews recorded with that user ID. Unlinked anonymous history is not assigned to this user.
error: Journeys could not be loaded. Retry or select a shorter date range.
searchError: User lookup is unavailable. Try the numeric user ID; email lookup requires profile-trait read access.
definition: Each row is an observed visit path, with consecutive repeats merged. Visits are separated after 30 minutes of inactivity; different identified users remain separate. Single-page visits are included.
ranking: Shown visits / all visits in scope
boundary: Some visits cross the date boundary or are still active. Their end is unknown, not a confirmed exit.
pageLimit: Some visits exceed 500 pageviews; only the first 500 are available in this report.
ambiguousOrder: Visits with different pages recorded at the same timestamp have uncertain order. They remain in total visits and are excluded from ordered paths and conversion:
choosePath: Choose a path from the list to inspect its conversion and visits.
conversionHint: Ordered consecutive prefixes within one visit, starting at the first observed page in this range. Counts at each step include every matching visit, not just the paths currently ranked above.
visitsHint: Newest first. Expand a visit to see its timestamps and original page paths.
